findings.title: A no-op git commit result is reported as a successful fix
findings.description: `commitPathsIfChanged` returns `null` when `git status` reports no changes, including when the target document is ignored. This code treats that result as success: the fix remains written in the non-invoking checkout, but no commit is recorded and the finding is not deferred. That breaks the stated contract that fixes in other checkouts are committed there. Handle the no-commit case explicitly rather than reporting it as successfully applied.

findings.title: Git probe failures are mislabeled as checkout state
findings.description: Both probes convert every `gitExec` failure into a state classification: a failed `rev-parse` becomes `NOT_A_CHECKOUT`, and a failed `symbolic-ref` becomes `DETACHED_HEAD`. Since these calls have a timeout, a timeout or another operational error can be silently reported as one of those states instead of surfaced as an error. Distinguish the expected probe result from failures such as timeouts.
